subject: Re: Shortburst tier renegotiation and temporary headroom
messages:
From: Alice Ramos <alice@sagehealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@sagehealth.com
Date: Fri, 05 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Shortburst opportunity — temporary headroom and discount ask

Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week — Sage Health is greenlighting an accelerated pilot for our clinical summarization feature and we expect a concentrated spike during our onboarding window (expected 5 business days starting July 10). Our current forecast suggests about 3x normal token volume for ~72 hours within that window.

Two asks: can Redwood provide a short-term uplift to our quota/rate-limit to cover the spike, and are you able to extend a pilot discount for the uplifted usage? Procurement is ready to send a PO if we can lock pricing and a temporary headroom window. I attached the PO draft (Sage_PO_20250701.pdf).

Key constraints:
- Start: July 10 (noon PT)
- Duration: up to 5 business days but highest intensity Jul 10–12
- Need clear overrun true-up terms and a cap on per-token overage rate if we exceed the uplift

Can you confirm feasibility and a proposed financial structure?

Best,
Alice Ramos
Head of Platform Integrations
Sage Health

Attachment: Sage_PO_20250701.pdf (application/pdf, stub)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Alice Ramos <alice@sagehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 05 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Shortburst opportunity — temporary headroom and discount ask

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear timeline and PO. Short answer: yes, we can support a shortburst uplift and provide a discounted uplift tier with an overrun true-up. I want to outline a pragmatic, low-friction structure so procurement can sign quickly.

Proposal (initial):
- Temporary headroom: +3x quota for 72 hours (Jul 10 12:00 PT — Jul 13 12:00 PT).
- Discount: 20% off our standard hosted overrun rate on the uplifted tokens for that 72-hour window.
- True-up: any consumption above the uplifted bucket during the window billed at the discounted overrun rate; we will provide a post-window usage report and a single consolidated invoice.
- Cap: a per-token surcharge cap (no more than 2x standard overrun) to protect you from runaway pricing.
- Commit conversion credit: if Sage converts the uplifted volume to a month-1 committed buffer within 30 days, we will credit 50% of the uplift discount applied as a one-time invoice credit.

I attached a short term sheet (temp_uplift_term_sheet.pdf) and a pricing comparison spreadsheet to show math. Ben — can you confirm finance OK with the 20% uplift discount + 50% conversion credit? Laura — can you help accelerate PO acceptance and DocuSign path if finance signs off?

If this sounds workable I can get legal to add a one-paragraph amendment to the master services agreement and we can DocuSign today.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing_comparison_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, stub); temp_uplift_term_sheet.pdf (application/pdf, stub)
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 05 Jul 2025 14:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Shortburst uplift — finance stance

Karthik / Laura — quick note from finance after reviewing the term sheet and expected uplift. High level OK with the structure; details below for legal & sales to finalize: 

Finance position (approved):
- 20% discount on uplifted tokens for the 72-hr window — approved.
- Post-window overrun billed at discounted rate; please ensure consumption reporting uses our token-metering export (we'll reconcile on the invoice).
- Cap: we accept a 2x surcharge ceiling (above standard overrun) for absolute protection.
- Credit: conversion credit is OK but limited to 30% of uplift discount (we need to preserve margin). If marketing/sales need 50% we require a signed 3-month trial addendum or minimum 10% committed spend increase next quarter.

Also, we want the PO attached to explicitly reference the uplift dates and the term-sheet id (temp-uplift-4831) so AP can match.

Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Alice Ramos <alice@sagehealth.com>, procure@sagehealth.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 07 Jul 2025 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Shortburst opportunity — temporary headroom and discount ask

Alice — looping back with updated terms from finance to keep things simple for procurement. Below is the final offer Redwood can sign to start July 10: 

Final offer (concise):
- Window: Jul 10 12:00 PT — Jul 13 12:00 PT (72 hours).
- Uplift: up to 3x your current quota for the window.
- Discount on uplifted tokens: 20% off standard hosted overrun rate.
- Overrun: any consumption beyond uplift during window billed at discounted overrun rate; post-window reconciliation invoice.
- Surcharge ceiling: maximum 2x standard overrun rate (protects you from runaway).
- Conversion credit: if Sage converts uplifted volume into a 3-month committed buffer within 30 days, Redwood will apply a conversion credit equal to 30% of the uplift discount (applied as a one-time invoice credit).
- Procurement requirement: PO must reference term-sheet id temp-uplift-4831 and include uplift start/end dates.

If that matches what you need, please confirm and we will send a one-paragraph amendment for signature and lock the uplift.

Thanks,
Karthik

Quoted message below (Ben's finance note).

2) Can Redwood provide a short consumption dashboard snapshot each morning during the window so we can monitor in near-real-time?

If both ok, I'll route PO today and request DocuSign. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Sage Health
